To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the level of the default risk premium in the corporate bond and credit derivative markets is not systematically underestimated by the Merton model; (2) the Merton model does a reasonable job at explaining the level of CDS premia; (3) bond premia are not underestimated when compared to the swap curve; and (4) the Merton default probability is a reasonable predictor of bond spreads.
